{{Top|leg}}
'''Electrotelescopes''' were optical devices that were used to observe nearby stellar bodies, such as [[Planet/Legends|planets]], [[Moon/Legends|moons]], and [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]. 

==Description==
Electrotelescopes worked on a similar principle to [[Electrobinoculars/Legends|electrobinoculars]] and [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]], although they were considerably more powerful. The devices had a high degree of magnification that was augmented by optics and [[Computer/Legends|computers]] that electronically enhanced light from existing sources and reduced visual distortions such as [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] haze.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

Electrotelescopes were also equipped with a number of [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] that detected energy emissions and scanned for transmissions from communications sources. The units used a two-stage system when scanning the surrounding area. A general scan covered a wide area, but in limited resolution and detail. If an anomalous reading was detected, the electrotelescope's computer would engage a more detailed scan focused on the area indicated. This allowed the electrotelescope to gather more detailed information. Using these scans, electrotelescopes were capable of detecting incoming small [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] at distances of up to five [[light-minute]]s out.<ref name="EGWT" />

Most models of electroscope have manual controls with interfaces that could allow [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]] and [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] to connect to the device. [[Communications transceiver]]s allowed the transmission and receipt of data from a central source, or as a means to link several electrotelescopes together to cover a wider area.<ref name="EGWT" />

Electrotelescopes ranged from small units that could be moved on [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] and weighed around thirty-five [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] up to larger units that required installation in an observatory or aboard a [[satellite]].<ref name="EGWT" />

==History==
Electrotelescopes were used as backups for [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] at [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]], aboard [[Space station/Legends|space stations]], and at [[Science/Legends|scientific]] deep-space observation stations. Planets used electrotelescopes as early-warning systems, while colonies used them to scan and track approaching asteroids and [[Comet/Legends|comets]].<ref name="EGWT" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] used electrotelescopes as early warning systems for their outposts on [[Tierfon/Legends|Tierfon]], [[Derra IV/Legends|Derra IV]], and [[Thila/Legends|Thila]]. The Alliance specifically used [[Neuro-Saav Technologies/Legends|Neuro-Saav Technologies']] [[VXI-3 electrotelescope]]s on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. As secrecy of the base was paramount, the Alliance could not employ active sensors or orbiting satellites.<ref name="EGWT" />
